thread.title: VEA, TCHF: Big ETF Inflows

author: BNK Invest
title: VEA, TCHF: Big ETF Inflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF ( VEA ), which added 7,001,849 units, or a 0.5% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of VEA, in morning trading today Nestle ( NSRGY ) is down about 0.7%, and Novartis ( NVS ) is up by about 0.5%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the iShares Edge MSCI Multifactor Technology ETF ( TCHF ), which added 50,000 units, for a 33.3% increase in outstanding units. Among the largest underlying components of TCHF, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is up about 1%, and Microsoft (MSFT) is up by about 0.5%.
